description: Live joint state saved 2026-09-24, manually jogged by the user to the closest safe radial approach of the source magnet to the beam base for this vessel shape -- SUPERSEDES the 2026-09-22 reference. Verified in-lab (safety_mode=1, not protective-stopped). Diagnosed as the likely cause of the weak/undetectable Jacobian signal in the 2026-09-24 stop-and-perturb campaign: this position sits at 183.7mm from the lumen centreline / 228.5mm from the beam base, vs. the 2026-09-22 reference's 314.2mm -- the old offline plan kept the magnet almost twice as far from the beam as necessary, well inside its real steering authority range. Used as --magnet-exclusion-reference-joints for proper_research.planning.plan_vessel_path, defining the minimum magnet-to-tip-path exclusion radius so the offline planner does not reject configurations that are physically fine.
